editorIntro: The Saturday markets are dark and truffle season is a week away: what's left is the Peninsula in its most deliberate register.

picks.editorVerdict: The lead booking this weekend. Penultimate session of the season — guided forage through Red Hill and Main Ridge forests, then lunch built from what the morning finds. Capped at 15. Book before Friday.
Two exhibitions closing 31 May. Free entry, no booking, works on either day. The easy late-morning Mornington move before coffee or lunch on Main Street.
Sunday 24 May is the final structured tasting session. Eight flavour samples, make your own rocky road, Flinders Chocolaterie. A clear reason to be in Flinders rather than anywhere else on Sunday.
Live music every Sunday afternoon from the amphitheatre pool stage. Included with afternoon bathing — no separate ticket. Runs through June. A low-key way to extend a Sunday at Rye.
